reviews.text:
What a pleasure it was to connect with Dianne at What A Good Dog. After doing some research and speaking to other training facilities having a real conversation with Dianne was a breath of fresh air.
We spoke on the phone and she listened. She asked questions and then listened again to immediately start giving me guidance and recommendations for our pup.
It felt like I was talking to a friend who wanted to help us help our pup. There was never a focus on "fixing our dog" like I heard from others, rather this was a focus on us helping Gibby be a better more respectful and integrated part of our family.
From that first conversation Dianne gave us tips and reccomendations on how to start helping Gibby with his energy and manners. I had not expected to get homework immediately which was incredible I could feel the desire Dianne had for helping us and that made all the difference.
I am truly grateful we found Dianne and What A Good Dog.

Dianne was a pleasure to work with! She made herself very available to us and was sympathetic to our needs.  Very knowledgeable and really helped us overcome some serious obstacles with our Yorkie puppy! Would absolutely recommend!

The best advice I was given regarding my dog, Sugar, came from What a good dog! LA. Dianne loves all pets and the love in her heart helped me with my puppy. I couldn’t be happier!!! Thanks Dianne
Jeanne

We had a wonderful experience with Dianne. She helped us build trust and a strong rapport with our rescue dog, who responded quickly to the basic obedience training. While we still have more work ahead, the change in her confidence has been dramatic. She has truly come out of her shell, and we are very grateful for the progress she has made.

I cannot thank Dianne enough. Barry is my first puppy and he came into my life at just six weeks old. I was completely overwhelmed, I was crying almost every day, and honestly wondered if I was cut out to be his owner. Barry and I were both struggling, and there were moments when I seriously considered giving up. Finding Dianne was a godsend. Of course Barry learned a ton, but Dianne also gave me the knowledge and confidence to understand him.  She taught me how to communicate with him and how to be a better leader for him. Dianne is incredibly knowledgeable, patient and supportive! She answered every question I had and fave me practical tools that made a huge difference in our day-to-day life.
If you’re bringing home a new puppy and want more structure and clarity, I can’t recommend Dianne highly enough.
Thank you, thank you, thank you Dianne. Barry and I appreciate you so much!

We had the pleasure of having Dianne come to our home to work with our new rescue puggle, Honey. Honey had come from instability and didn’t have a leader to rely on for what she viewed as protection. She barked incessantly in the house and was extremely reactive on leash. Within one day of using Dianne’s methods, Honey is already doing so much better. She looks to us when she hears or sees a trigger, instead of feeling like she needs to be the protector. She still has a ways to go with practicing these commands but it’s like a switch flipped!! So grateful to What a Good Dog for helping our Honey. Photo attached of Honey being calm even with the windows open (something we never thought possible!).

We came in struggling with separation anxiety and excessive barking, and the progress we’ve made has been amazing. Diane spent so much time with her hands-on training approach and words of encouragement. Her training methods were clear, effective, and tailored to our dog’s needs. I appreciated how she went out of her way to help us with specific issues and was very patient every step of the way. Thanks so much Diane!

Before working with her, this household was in a very difficult place. They had recently adopted a stray, and their existing dog was extremely reactive and at times aggressive toward the new addition. The tension in the home was constant, and they were genuinely concerned about whether the dogs would ever be able to coexist safely.

She completely transformed the situation.

Through a calm, structured, and highly knowledgeable approach, she identified the root of the reactivity and implemented clear, practical strategies that the owners could realistically follow. The results were remarkable. The dogs not only learned to coexist, but now genuinely get along.

The overall energy of the home has shifted. Walks are manageable, daily life is calmer, and what once felt overwhelming now feels stable and peaceful. Adopting their stray has become one of the best decisions they’ve made — and that is directly because of her guidance.

She didn’t just train the dogs; she changed the dynamic of the entire household. Highly recommend.

Dianne is a lifesaver! I recently got my dog and she was on anxiety meds at the shelter and once I brought her home she did not listen at all. Wasn't potty trained, had severe separation anxiety, pulled on the leash so hard and didn't know how to relax in the house. Dianne helped me fix all these issues! My dog is much happier now and so am I!

Diane is an absolute gift of a human. It’s been mentioned in so many reviews but she really teaches more than dog obedience. We adopted our dog Chipper while expecting a baby and we wanted to ensure he would be a good family member. After working with Diane we have the best boy we could ask for! Diane is really a behaviorist and leadership trainer. If you are even on the fence about seeking her help you should jump. You will create a bond that promotes confidence and an understanding of what your dog expects from you as an owner and leader. We will forever be grateful for her love and attention and would take every dog we ever own to her as soon as possible!
